newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST-Italy mkt sees rates 50bp lower in month.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Italy mkt sees rates 50bp lower in month.

text.p: The Italian money market has tempered its expectations of how far Italy is likely to reduce interest rates over the coming month, a study by the Igier research arm of the Bocconi University showed on Friday.
The study, based on implicit forward rates, shows the implicit overnight rate standing at 7.44 percent in one month compared with a forecast a week ago of 7.01 percent.
This compares with an actual overnight rate of 7.94 percent on Thursday, the day on which Igier based its study, up from an actual rate of 7.75 percent a week ago.
The Bank of Italy last lowered its official discount rate and its fixed term advances or Lombard rate by 75 basis points on October 24 to 7.5 and 9.0 percent respectively.
On a three-month horizon, the implicit overnight rate is plotted at 6.72 percent compared with expectations a week ago for 6.86 percent over the same timeframe and 6.75 percent a month ago.

Over the one year horizon, however, expectations remain little changed with the implicit overnight rate seen at 6.01 percent this week, compared with 6.02 percent last week and 5.86 percent a month ago.
In two years, the overnight rate is forecast at 6.90 percent, compared with expectations for 6.64 percent last week.

The spread between the Italian implicit overnight rate two years ahead and the same German rate two years ahead, seen as a good indicator for market confidence in European economic and monetary union, is 206 basis points after 197 a week ago and 180 a month ago.
